expected_structural_delta: No new production modules, roots, state owners, protocols, or public operations. Extend one descriptor-generation boundary and add one focused artifact test.
minimum_design: Escape the selected changelog body only at the existing descriptor-generation boundary, then parse a generated descriptor containing ampersands and angle brackets.
outcome: When selected changelog text contains XML metacharacters, the generated .plg descriptor remains well-formed and XML consumers recover the original visible characters.

reuse_decisions.name: build-plg.sh changelog selection
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing build script already selects the changelog body. Escaping immediately before descriptor insertion preserves the source text and limits the representation change.

reuse_decisions.name: tests/xml-escape.sh
reuse_decisions.rationale: A focused generated-artifact test is needed because shell syntax checks cannot prove XML well-formedness or entity expansion.
